# Glyph reference

Each glyph has a name, which links to its definitions and examples. A function glyph also has a name for its monad, which takes one argument, and for its dyad, which takes two. Operators take functions or arrays and derive functions. Notes give glyph-specific differences from Dyalog APL. Examples show an equivalent APL value after `⍝`.

## Typing glyphs

Hold Alt, or Alt and Shift, and press the key in the Key column. Keys refer to a US layout. A glyph with no key, such as `+`, is on an ordinary ASCII key. The layout keeps Dyalog positions where practical, puts the arrows on hjkl, and uses spare keys for bAsedPL's additions. Alt-[ and Alt-Shift-o are left vacant, because terminals encode them as the start of control sequences. Alt-Shift-h gives `∆` and Alt-Shift-. gives `⍙`, which are identifier characters.

The names are the ones you type. In the REPL, a backtick and any glyph, monad or dyad name, then Tab, enters the glyph, as [named entry](repl.qmd#named-entry) describes. Python exports the function names, with `_` in place of `-` and a trailing `_` on Python keywords, as in `index_of` and `and_`.

| `-` [dash](glyphs/dash.qmd) | | negate | subtract | Character difference as BQN: `'d'-'a'` is `3x` |
| `×` [mul](glyphs/mul.qmd) | Alt-Minus | sign | times | |
| `÷` [div](glyphs/div.qmd) | Alt-= | reciprocal | divide | Exact rationals as J: `1x÷3x` is `1r3` |
| `⌊` [floor](glyphs/floor.qmd) | Alt-d | floor | min | `⌊/⍬` is `∞` |
| `⌈` [ceiling](glyphs/ceiling.qmd) | Alt-s | ceiling | max | `⌈/⍬` is `¯∞` |
| `\|` [stile](glyphs/stile.qmd) | | magnitude | residue | |
| `*` [star](glyphs/star.qmd) | | exponential | exponent | |
| `⍟` [log](glyphs/log.qmd) | Alt-Shift-8 | logarithm | log | |
| `○` [circle](glyphs/circle.qmd) | Alt-o | cis | circle | Monad is `*0j1×Y`, a unit-circle point. Pi times is `π` |

| `↓` [drop](glyphs/drop.qmd) | Alt-j | split | drop | |

## Operators

`f`, `g` are functions; `a`, `n`, `r` are arrays or numbers.

| Glyph | Key | Form | Meaning | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/` [slash](glyphs/slash.qmd) | | `f/` | Reduce / seeded reduce last | Seed as BQN's `´`: `10 -/1 2 3` is `¯8`. For windows use `↕` |
| `⌿` [slash-bar](glyphs/slash-bar.qmd) | Alt-/ | `f⌿` | Reduce / seeded reduce first | Seed and windows as `/` |
| `\` [backslash](glyphs/backslash.qmd) | | `f\` | Scan / seeded scan last | Accumulates left to right as BQN's Scan: `-\1 2 3` is `1 ¯1 ¯4` |
| `⍀` [backslash-bar](glyphs/backslash-bar.qmd) | Alt-. | `f⍀` | Scan / seeded scan first | Left to right as `\` |
| `¨` [each](glyphs/each.qmd) | Alt-1 | `f¨` | Each | |
| `⍨` [commute](glyphs/commute.qmd) | Alt-Shift-t | `f⍨`, `a⍨` | Self / commute / constant | |
| `⊸` [before](glyphs/before.qmd) | Alt-u | `f⊸g`, `a⊸f` | Before / bind left | As BQN's `⊸` |
| `⟜` [after](glyphs/after.qmd) | Alt-t | `f⟜g`, `f⟜a` | After / bind right | As BQN's `⟜` |
| `⍤` [rank](glyphs/rank.qmd) | Alt-Shift-j | `f⍤g`, `f⍤r` | Atop / rank | |
| `⍠` [axis](glyphs/axis.qmd) | Alt-Shift-/ | `f⍠A` | Apply along axes | Axes are numbers or names, in place of Dyalog's `f[A]` |
| `⍥` [over](glyphs/over.qmd) | Alt-Shift-v | `f⍥g` | Over | |
| `.` [dot](glyphs/dot.qmd) | | `f.g` | Inner product | Outer product is `g⌝`. After an array, `T.name` is `"name"⊃T`, and `x.(I)` is `(I)⌷x` |
| `⌝` [outer-product](glyphs/outer-product.qmd) | Alt-7 | `g⌝` | Outer product | As BQN's `⌜`; `∘.g` is a `SYNTAX` error |
| `⌸` [key](glyphs/key.qmd) | Alt-Shift-k | `f⌸` | Key | |
| `⍣` [power](glyphs/power.qmd) | Alt-Shift-p | `f⍣n`, `f⍣∞`, `f⍣g`, `f⍣[g;]` | Iterate / invert / fixed point / repeat until / history until | A list of counts gives the result for each count, as J's `^:` and BQN's `⍟`: `(1+⍣3 ¯2 0 3)10` is `13 8 10 13` |
| `⇄` [inverse-pair](glyphs/inverse-pair.qmd) | Alt-5 | `f⇄g` | Attach an explicit inverse | As J's `:.` |
| `⌾` [under](glyphs/under.qmd) | Alt-m | `f⌾g` | Transform, apply, inverse-transform | As J's `&.` |
| `∂` [derivative](glyphs/derivative.qmd) | Alt-f | `f∂` | Gradient / vector–Jacobian product | |
| `◶` [agenda](glyphs/agenda.qmd) | Alt-y | `selector◶cases` | Select and call one function | As BQN's `◶` |
| `@` [at](glyphs/at.qmd) | | `f@a`, `a@g` | Functional amend | |
| `⌺` [stencil](glyphs/stencil.qmd) | Alt-Shift-Backtick | `f⌺a` | Stencil | |

## Syntax and literals

| Form | Key | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `←` [assign](glyphs/assign.qmd) | Alt-h | Assignment, including modified and selective forms |
| `→` [pipe](glyphs/pipe.qmd) | Alt-l | Left-to-right function application |
| `(…)` [parentheses](glyphs/parentheses.qmd) | | Grouping |
| `[…]` [brackets](glyphs/brackets.qmd) | | Lists and arrays: `[a b c]`, `[a;b c]`, `[1 2 ⋄ 3 4]`. One item only groups: `[x]` is `x`, and `[x;]` is a one-item list |
| `{…}` [braces](glyphs/braces.qmd) | | Defined function or operator |
| `⍺` [alpha](glyphs/alpha.qmd), `⍵` [omega](glyphs/omega.qmd) | Alt-a, Alt-w | Left / right argument |
| `⍶` [alpha-underbar](glyphs/alpha-underbar.qmd), `⍹` [omega-underbar](glyphs/omega-underbar.qmd) | Alt-Shift-a, Alt-Shift-w | Left / right operand |
| `∇` [del](glyphs/del.qmd), `⍢` [del-diaeresis](glyphs/del-diaeresis.qmd) | Alt-g, Alt-Shift-g | Function / operator self-reference |
| `:` [colon](glyphs/colon.qmd), `::` [error-guard](glyphs/error-guard.qmd) | | Unkey / key axes; Boolean guard / error guard inside dfns |
| `⋄` [diamond](glyphs/diamond.qmd) | Alt-Backtick | Separates statements, and rows inside brackets |
| `⍝` [comment](glyphs/comment.qmd) | Alt-, | Comment |
| `⎕←` [quad](glyphs/quad.qmd) | Alt-] | Explicit output |
| `•` [bullet](glyphs/bullet.qmd) | Alt-q | [System name](#system-names) prefix |
| `⍬` [zilde](glyphs/zilde.qmd) | Alt-Shift-] | Empty numeric vector |
| `'…'` `"…"` [quote](glyphs/quote.qmd) | | Character and string literals |
| `¯` [overbar](glyphs/overbar.qmd) | Alt-2 | Negative literal sign |
| `∞` [infinity](glyphs/infinity.qmd) | Alt-Shift-Minus | Real infinity |

Numeric notation `x`, `r`, `j`, `E`: see [numbers](rules.qmd#numbers).

## System names

Names are case-insensitive. `•a` and `•d` are constant arrays; the other names are functions, usable with operators and composition.

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `•a` [Alphabet](glyphs/alphabet.qmd) | Uppercase Latin alphabet |
| `•d` [Digits](glyphs/digits.qmd) | Decimal digits |
| `•c` [Case](glyphs/case.qmd) | Unicode case conversion |
| `•csv` [CSV](data.ipynb#csv) | CSV text → keyed column vectors |
| `•tocsv` [CSV](data.ipynb#csv) | Keyed column vectors → CSV text |
| `•r` [Regex](regex.ipynb) | Compiled search, captures and replacement |
| `•normal`, `•binomial`, … [Distributions](distributions.ipynb) | Sampling, density, CDF and quantiles; 17 families |
| `•json` [JSON](data.ipynb#json) | JSON text → arrays and keyed vectors |
| `•tojson` [JSON](data.ipynb#json) | Arrays and keyed vectors → JSON text |
| `•vfi` [Numeric input](data.ipynb#numeric-input) | Parse numeric fields with a validity mask |
| `•nget` [Read](data.ipynb#files) | Read UTF-8 text or bytes |
| `•nput` [Write](data.ipynb#files) | Write UTF-8 text or bytes |
| `•element`, `•xml`, `•svg` [XML and SVG](xml.ipynb) | Build, serialize and display element trees |
| `•mime` [Rich display](xml.ipynb#rich-display) | The MIME bundle that display uses |
| `•plot` [Plots](plot.ipynb) | Charts from vectors, matrices and tables |
| `•ucs` [Unicode](glyphs/unicode.qmd) | Unicode code points / encodings |
| `•load` [Load](glyphs/load.qmd) | Evaluate an APL source file |
| `•signal` [Signal](glyphs/error-guard.qmd#signal) | Raise an ordinary APL error |
| `•nc` [Name class](introspection.ipynb) | Classify visible names |
| `•nl` [Name list](introspection.ipynb) | List names by class and prefix |
| `•src` [Source](introspection.ipynb) | Function/operator source |
| `•ex` [Expunge](introspection.ipynb) | Erase bindings |

Index origin: 0. Negative positions and axes count from the end. Comparison tolerance: `1E¯14`.

## Language-wide differences from Dyalog APL

- [Lists](glyphs/brackets.qmd): brackets write lists, `[a b c]`, and a list of literals can leave them out, `1 2 3`. Brackets round one item only group it, so `[x]` is `x`. Nothing else strands, so arrays next to each other don't form a list.
- [Runs](rules.qmd): outside brackets, a space separates runs, and each run is evaluated first: `a+b × c+d` is `(a+b)×(c+d)`. A run that ends in a function is a train: `+/÷≢` is the mean, and `2×` is `2⊸×`.
- [Array application](glyphs/squad.qmd): an array next to an argument selects from it, as K does: `v 0` is the first item of `v`.
- [Atoms](rules.qmd#arrays-nesting-and-fill): numbers, characters and functions are atoms, distinct from scalars, as BQN. Enclosing always adds a layer: `(⊂3)≡3` is `0x`.
- [Numbers](rules.qmd#numbers): bare numbers are approximate. `x` and `r` mark exact integers and rationals, as J: `1x÷3x` is `1r3`. Predicates, positions, tally and shape are exact.
- [Agreement](rules.qmd#agreement-and-pervasion): scalar functions, Each and Rank align leading axes, and dimensions of length 1 expand: `(2 3⍴⍳6)+10 20` is `[10 11 12 ⋄ 23 24 25]`.
- [System names](#system-names): written `•name`, as BQN, not `⎕NAME`. Most Dyalog system functions and variables are not included.
- [Axis keys](keyed.qmd) name data. `K:Y` evaluates its keys. `T.a` is `"a"⊃T`, and `X⍎Y` is `Y⊃X`.
